scope: Stock G2/G4 safe-range arithmetic characterization; installed upstream clients only, NOT adapter validation/signoff

probe.trailbase: Serialized the safe offset and limit in one request; returned an empty page.
probe.supabase: Serialized the equivalent range as offset=9007199254740991&limit=2 in one request; returned HTTP 200 with an empty page.

interpretation: The installed clients accept a safe offset whose requested page end is outside the safe-integer domain. The approved future adapter contract rejects page bounds when safe range arithmetic overflows before sending a request; this probe does not implement that guard.
explicitNonClaims: No adapter request-count/rejection implementation or G2/G4 gate signoff.
No exact count or cross-backend out-of-range total guarantee.
